mapper.update: UPDATE provider_attempt SET owner = #{owner}, lease_until = DATE_ADD(NOW(3), INTERVAL #{leaseSeconds} SECOND), generation = generation + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND (lease_until IS NULL OR lease_until < NOW(3)) AND (state IN ('SUBMIT_PENDING','SUBMITTING','RECONCILING','ACCEPTED','RUNNING','REVIEW') OR (state = 'RESULT_PENDING' AND (result_ref IS NULL OR result_ref = '' OR result_digest IS NULL OR result_digest = '')))
